question: Which of the following states was the overall champion in both men and women categories in the first Janjatiya Khel Mahotsav?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Odisha emerged as the overall champion in both men and women categories in the first Janjatiya Khel Mahotsav.
 
• The event saw participation from various states, but Odisha dominated in terms of overall performance.
 
• Odisha's athletes showcased exceptional talent and skills, leading to their top position.
 
• The state has been investing in sports infrastructure and athlete development, which is reflected in their performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Janjatiya Khel Mahotsav**

 
 
• The Janjatiya Khel Mahotsav is a national sports event organized to promote and encourage the participation of tribal communities in sports.
 
• This event aims to recognize and nurture the sporting talent in tribal areas, providing a platform for athletes to showcase their skills.
 
• The initiative is part of the government's efforts to promote sports among marginalized communities and ensure their inclusion in the national sports ecosystem.
 
• The event includes various sports competitions, workshops, and cultural programs to celebrate the heritage and talent of tribal communities.
 
 
 
• **Sports Infrastructure in Odisha**
 
 
• Odisha has been making significant strides in developing sports infrastructure, including the construction of world-class facilities and training centers.
 
• The state has hosted several national and international sports events, showcasing its capability to support large-scale sports competitions.
 
• Odisha's government has been proactive in providing financial support and incentives to athletes, ensuring they have the resources needed to excel.
 
• The focus on sports development has helped Odisha produce top athletes who compete at national and international levels.
